audit.why: Early belongs to Neeko (Q 800 / E 1000 range poke, clone roams); Malzahar inverts the lane at 6 — point-click suppression stops Pop Blossom and Neeko has no escape but Shapesplitter's brief speed. Page reflects this; only the full-layer chart lagged.
Spikes: Neeko 3-5, Malzahar 6 / first item / late. All 4 spikes[] present and match the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer swapped Neeko's ability slots: Q is Blooming Burst, E is Tangle-Barbs, but spikes[0] wrote 'Tangle-Barbs (Q) and Blooming Burst (E)', spikes[2] and wants.you[2] called the root her Q. Full layer advised 'sidestep it behind minions' — Riot's text says the tangle roots everything it passes through and grows larger and faster through units, so minions feed it rather than block it. 'Iron Boundary' is a fabricated name for Malzahar's passive Void Shift. No cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Kit file: Neeko Q 9-7s, W 16-12s, E 12-10s root, R 120/105/90 (leap prep hidden while disguised); Malzahar Q 6s silence stops the E wind-up, R suppression pre-empts Pop Blossom.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, minion-block advice replaced with the grows-through-units fact, real cooldowns added.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 misgendered fields, two copy-paste-bleed bullets, unsupported 'doubles your', cooldowns field with no digit, full chart all-Skill while content reads Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Malz/Malz/Malz.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your spell shield (Iron Boundary) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
